label: R19-TIMING-BATCH
title: Integrate and validate the R19 core-control and FP balanced-scan lanes

members.goal: shorten the residual core FP response-ready control cone without changing transaction ownership
replace round_pack_scan's 256-bit linear priority search with a balanced encoder

timing_input.status: R18 remote candidate is synced but synthesis has not started because the remote interactive workload remains material

scope: Review and cherry-pick the two mutually disjoint R19 member commits into one candidate, resolve only integration test assumptions, then run the focused member tests followed by the complete affected L0-L2 union on one exact candidate SHA. Physical validation is a later exact-SHA task after functional acceptance and resource admission.
writes: member RTL and tests through reviewed cherry-picks
integration-only test or registry changes needed to run member tests

validation.focused: T-021 core response-control SV/Cocotb and T-022 scalar balanced-scan exhaustive focused test
validation.l0_l1: registered affected core/backpressure/MMU/IRQ/FP direct/P7 union including T-012 natural overlap and expected-fail BFM
validation.l2: strict QEMU lockstep union selected from the last green R18 A-F matrix
validation.physical: not part of this task; create a fresh exact-R19 physical task only after local validation passes

acceptance: Both member diffs pass independent review, focused tests and the affected L0-L2 union on one exact SHA. No timing improvement is claimed until synthesis/fitter/signoff STA reports top-N and directional paths.
resource: One heavy local queue at CPU<=50%, MemoryMax=16G, MemorySwapMax=0 and VERILATOR_JOBS=1. RTL analysis and review may continue in parallel outside the heavy queue.

local_validation.focused: registry plus balanced-scan, FP wrapper, core response-hold SV and standalone Cocotb
local_validation.l0_l1: affected union pass; T-012 natural FP/data-MMU overlap blocked_cycles=3 consume=1 exmem_captures=1 fp_commits=1 load_commits=1
local_validation.l2: strict D+E affected union pass; 1155 commits

board_policy: No Quartus assembler, SOF/JIC/RBF/POF/JBC/SVF/JAM, JTAG, programming, power-on or board test without explicit user permission.
